text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $84k while Ethereum has slipped slightly, suggesting consolidation rather than conviction in either direction at current levels. The Fear & Greed index at 71 with a sharp 15-point weekly climb indicates sentiment has swung decisively into greed territory, though Bitcoin's flat 24-hour performance hints traders aren't yet testing higher. Volume at $107B is moderate for the macro context, and Bitcoin's 58.6% dominance shows altcoins are holding their own rather than capitulating, a sign the rally isn't dominated by panic buying into a single asset.
